jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing
jobs.description: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing We operate a regulated digital asset exchange, broker, and custodian serving institutional and professional investors. Our QA practice has been rebuilt around agentic AI: test planning, test code, failure triage, and even code review happens in partnership with AI coding agents, with the engineer as the human in the loop. We're looking for an SDET to join that team. Judgment, curiosity, and clear writing matter more to us than a perfect CV — if you're strong, we're flexible on the rest. What the role actually is You won't spend your days hand-writing boilerplate test scripts. You'll direct AI agents to do the mechanical work, and your job is everything the machine can't be trusted with deciding what's worth testing, checking that a generated test can genuinely fail, spotting when a "passing" suite is lying, and judging whether a red run is a product bug, an environment problem, or a broken test. What you'll do Author and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, TypeScript) covering the trading, custody, and customer-portal surfaces of the platform. Work with agentic AI tools daily — planning tests, generating code, triaging failures, reviewing PRs — and critically verify everything an agent produces before it ships. Triage nightly regression and smoke runs: separate genuine product bugs from environment noise and test-side defects, and file clear, well-evidenced bug reports that a developer outside your domain can act on. Keep the suite honest: link failing tests to known bugs, release them when fixes land, and never let a silent skip or a warning-instead-of-failure hide a real defect. Run and maintain suites in CI (GitHub Actions) and help keep the pipelines green, fast, and trustworthy. Keep test cases traceable in our test-case-management tooling. Occasionally cross the test boundary and fix what you find: QA works in the same monorepo as the product, so small bug fixes and improvements to the application itself are yours to ship, through the same PR and review process the developers use. Review teammates' test PRs — and respond to review findings on your own, including findings raised by AI reviewers — with evidence, not opinion. Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product owners across a globally distributed team. What we're looking for Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, or software development — typically 3–6 years, though we're flexible for the right person. Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, or clear evidence you can pick a language up quickly. A solid grasp of how web applications and HTTP APIs work: requests and responses, status codes, JSON, authentication. Genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering. You should be comfortable making AI tools do real work — and sceptical enough to check the output. If you already use AI assistants for real tasks, we'll want to hear how. Excellent written English. In an agentic workflow, writing is the work: prompts, bug reports, test plans, and review comments all succeed or fail on clarity. Attention to detail and honest reporting. A failing test you explain truthfully is worth more to us than a green one you can't. Strong candidates usually bring several of the following — you don't need them all: Hands-on experience with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium). Experience building or maintaining a shared test framework — fixtures, page objects, helpers, CI wiring — rather than only writing specs inside one. Exposure to financial services, trading, or capital markets — order lifecycles, settlement, custody concepts. WebSockets / real-time data, SQL/PostgreSQL, CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar). Familiarity with digital assets or blockchain. Nice to have Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar). ﻿Work Setup: Shift: ﻿Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–8:00 PM Setup: Remote By Applying, you give consent to collect, store, and/or process personal and/or sensitive information for the purpose of recruitment and employment may it be internal to Cobden & Carter International and/or to its clients. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. What we're looking for: We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating. You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform. In this role, you will: Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC. Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on. Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations. Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build. Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights. jobs.description: At Canadian Solar, our vision is to make lives better by bringing electricity powered by the sun to millions of people worldwide. Join e-STORAGE ! Who We Are Welcome to e-STORAGE , a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone. With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide. Role Overview for Senior Performance Engineer In this role, you’ll bring together the sharp analytical mindset of a controls engineer and the hands‑on problem‑solving instincts of a commissioning engineer to efficiently troubleshoot complex issues and pinpoint root causes on operating systems. You’ll take ownership of diagnosing performance challenges and work closely with internal teams and external vendors to drive solutions, validating and evaluating firmware and software updates to ensure system security and reliability, minimizing downtime. Your insights will feed back to internal teams and product improvements to drive a cycle of continuous improvement. If you thrive on tackling new challenges, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and love the satisfaction of solving problems that matter, this role keeps you continuously engaged and at the center of meaningful, hands‑on innovation. What You’ll Be Doing as a Senior Performance Controls Engineer Prioritize, investigate, and drive the corrective action for performance issues identified during facility operation. Troubleshooting and root cause analysis using data analysis, first principles, on site investigation, or other means as needed. Validate software/firmware updates in coordination with vendors, the site service team, and relevant stakeholders to confirm documented changes and no unintended consequences are introduced. Coordinate subsequent rollouts with the appropriate site service teams. Effectively communicate issues to the appropriate vendor and stakeholders to ensure resolutions are identified and implemented. Support performance testing as required under individual contracts for each facility. Contribute to fleet wide efforts for improving the efficacy of monitoring and analysis processes and tools. Collaborate with internal teams to provide input to improve performance across the business from applications and design to project execution and commissioning to service. Provide documentation of issues and resolutions for tracking, knowledge sharing, and internal and external communications. Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with safety protocols, engineering standards, and company policies. What You’ll Bring to the Position Demonstrated experience in customer-focused problem solving Ability to execute projects and tasks in parallel, self-directed, highly detail-oriented, organized and flexible Experience troubleshooting using data analytics Experience in commissioning, performance testing, maintenance, and/or design of BESS or other power generating facilities Knowledge and experience with SCADA protocols (i.e. DNP3 and Modbus) Familiarity with industrial communication networks (fiber optics, network switches, TCP/IP, etc.) Excellent communication skills Ability to travel up to 20% of time. Travel may be on short notice Demonstrated experience in problem solving What It’s Like to Work Here At e-STORAGE , you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find: Integrity: We do what’s right, always. Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas. Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time. Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver. Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience. Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world. Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority. Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package. Want to join here is what we are looking For The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role. Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities. A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability. Your Rewards We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more. Our Commitment to Equality & Diversity “At e-STORAGE , we know that diverse teams drive innovation and better results. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered—regardless of age, race, gender, ability, or background. When you join us, you’re joining a community that celebrates your uniqueness and supports your success.” — Libby, Sr. Global HR Manager Originally posted on Himalayas
